criterion: which general domain of assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Banking & Finance
categories.definition: Utterances related to managing personal finances, bank accounts, credit cards, loans, bills, and financial transactions.

categories.name: Travel & Navigation
categories.definition: Utterances concerning travel planning, booking transportation or accommodation, navigation, location services, and travel-related information.

categories.name: Personal Organization & Scheduling
categories.definition: Utterances related to managing personal schedules, appointments, to-do lists, reminders, and tracking personal items or requests.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: Utterances for purchasing items, placing orders, or managing shopping lists for procurement.

categories.name: Vehicle Maintenance & Information
categories.definition: Utterances related to vehicle maintenance, status, fuel, or general car-related information.

categories.name: Media Control
categories.definition: Utterances to control media playback, manage playlists, or identify songs.

categories.name: Assistant & Device Control
categories.definition: Utterances that control the assistant's settings, voice, name, or directly interact with device functionalities like volume, lights, pairing, or making calls.

categories.name: General Knowledge & Information
categories.definition: Utterances seeking factual information, definitions, explanations, recipes, nutritional data, weather, time, or general knowledge.

categories.name: General Interaction & Small Talk
categories.definition: Utterances for casual conversation, greetings, acknowledgements, expressions of gratitude, or non-task-specific interactions.
